author: codex-root

findings.summary: The legacy context-info shortcut cannot upgrade an already-open quick search dialog.
findings.consequence: If a user opens quick search with the normal shortcut and then presses the legacy info shortcut, the dialog remains open but the contextual developer information is not shown; the user must close and reopen with F20 or type /info.
findings.evidence: Line 75 returns immediately whenever quickSearchOpen is already true, before line 76 can update quickSearchInfoRequested. The child QuickSearch component only consumes showContextInfoInitially during its mounted callback, and the E2E coverage exercises F20 only from a closed dialog state.
findings.recommendation: When showContextInfo is true and quickSearchOpen is already true, forward an explicit signal to QuickSearch or expose the same showContextInfo action through the parent instead of returning before the info request is recorded.
verification: Read app/components/global/QuickSearch.vue lines 383-389, which only apply showContextInfoInitially on mount.
Read test/e2e/quick-search-developer.behavior.spec.ts lines 105-120; coverage opens the info shortcut from closed state only.

Inspected app/components/global/SiteShell.vue, app/lib/production-shortcuts.ts, app/components/global/QuickSearch.vue, and direct layout callers app/layouts/default.vue and app/layouts/reader.vue via ripgrep results.
